name: verifiable-settlement-yarn
description: Commands that must pass after any change, one per eligibility requirement so a failure names the requirement. None needs credentials, a .env or network access beyond the package registry.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install every workspace from the committed lockfile, without changing it.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: ESLint in every workspace, zero warnings.

commands.name: test
commands.purpose: SDK unit tests and Hardhat contract tests (deterministic, no Testnet).

commands.name: build
commands.purpose: SDK build, contract compilation and Next.js production build.
